```{r}
campus <- jsonlite::fromJSON("https://isa401-find-your-seat.vercel.app/campus.json")

library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# Read the campus JSON file
campus_data <- fromJSON("https://isa401-find-your-seat.vercel.app/campus.json")

# Filter for Farmer School of Business and extract floor 1 sections
fsb_data <- campus_data$buildings %>%
  filter(name == "Farmer School of Business")

# Unnest floors and rooms to count total class sections on floor 1
floor1_rooms <- fsb_data$floors[[1]] %>%
  filter(floor == 1)

total_sections <- sum(sapply(floor1_rooms$rooms[[1]]$sections, length))
print(total_sections)

```

```{r Game}
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

# 1. Setup Base URL and Pagination Sequence
# Update 'to = ' with the last page start number based on total wrecks
base_url <- "https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app/exam/registry?start="
starts <- seq(from = 1, to = 321, by = 40) # Adjust 321 if total wrecks differs

# 2. Scrape across all pages
pages <- vector("list", length(starts))

for (i in seq_along(starts)) {
  pg <- read_html(paste0(base_url, starts[i]))
  
  pages[[i]] <- data.frame(
    # Extract class name and clean label/whitespace
    class = pg |> 
      html_elements("div > ul > li:nth-child(1) > span") |> 
      html_text2() |> 
      str_remove("Class:\\s*") |> 
      str_trim(),
    
    # Extract value as numeric
    value = pg |> 
      html_elements("div > ul > li:nth-child(3) > span") |> 
      html_text2() |> 
      parse_number()
  )
  
  Sys.sleep(1) # Polite scraping pause
}

# 3. Combine into single data frame
registry <- bind_rows(pages)

# Answer to Part 2: Extract vector of all classes
classes <- registry$class

# Answer to Part 3: Count Dreadnoughts
dreadnought_count <- sum(registry$class == "Dreadnought")
print(dreadnought_count)


library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

# 1. Setup Base URL and Pagination Sequence
base_url <- "https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app/exam/registry?start="
starts <- seq(from = 1, to = 321, by = 40)

# 2. Scrape across all pages
pages <- vector("list", length(starts))

for (i in seq_along(starts)) {
  pg <- read_html(paste0(base_url, starts[i]))
  
  pages[[i]] <- data.frame(
    class = pg |> 
      html_elements("div > ul > li:nth-child(1) > span") |> 
      html_text2() |> 
      str_remove("Class:\\s*") |> 
      str_trim(),
    
    value = pg |> 
      html_elements("div > ul > li:nth-child(3) > span") |> 
      html_text2() |> 
      parse_number()
  )
  
  Sys.sleep(1) # Polite scraping pause
}

# 3. Combine into data frame and extract the 'classes' vector
registry <- bind_rows(pages)
classes <- registry$class

```{r}
library(ellmer)

# 1. Create a chat object
chat <- chat_openai(
  model = "gpt-5.6-luna"
)

# 2. Define the Airbnb listing description
description <- "This one of a kind, turn of the century, fully restored mansion is just waiting for you to come and enjoy the vast amenities this house offers! This historic Victorian Mansion was built in the last 1800's and has been fully restored and updated with one thing in mind--luxury! We boast a slate pool table, 10 person hot tub, a custom made fire table, a built in giant projector screen for streaming, arcade games, and much much more! We comfortably sleep 19 guests with 9 dedicated bedrooms."

# 3. Extract structured information
result <- chat$chat_structured(
  description,
  type = type_object(
    property_type = type_string(
      description = "The type of property, e.g., Mansion, Apartment, House"
    ),
    max_guests = type_integer(
      description = "The maximum number of guests the property sleeps"
    ),
    num_bedrooms = type_integer(
      description = "The number of dedicated bedrooms"
    ),
    key_amenities = type_string(
      description = "List key amenities separated by |"
    )
  )
)

# 4. Display results
print(result)
